children: The National Cryptocurrency Association (NCA), a U.S. nonprofit crypto education group, released an interactive map estimating that about 67 million Americans hold cryptocurrency across all 50 states, Washington, D.C., and all 435 congressional districts in the 119th Congress. According to Odaily, the estimates are model-based and not verified holder counts.

California has the largest estimated number of holders at about 9.5 million, followed by Texas with 5.94 million, Florida with 4.71 million, New York with 4.66 million, and Illinois with 2.64 million. A separate analysis commissioned by NCA and conducted by Pragmatic Policy Group said the crypto industry supports 231,800 jobs in the U.S., generates $55.4 billion in economic activity, and provides $30.8 billion in worker income, including about 34,000 direct jobs.

title: NCA Estimates 67 Million Americans Hold Crypto Across All 50 States
